messages.subject: disorder blocks on  a chromosome
parts:
Hi Dr. Broman,

I got the first map draft and have been working on improving it for the past week. 
I have a problem and can't find the solution through the manual. 

I don't know the SNPs physical position but their physical position  is known. I exported the map, compared SNPs' genetic position and physical order, and found 3 blocks on one chromosome. Within each block, the SNPs were in correct physical order but these blocks' position were not in the known physical order. 

Here is one example I plotted out as below. I matched the genetic order with physical order on the chromosome (the x-axis is the known physical order, the y-axis is cM position from R/qtl.). The 3 blocks on the same chromosome were not in the correct order. I also checked the big gap was between the middle part and the end block. 

I also used "ripple()", and it told me the markers which need to be switched order were only in the end block. It doesn't make sense to me. 

Is there nay other way I can use to correct the block order? Thanks so much for your time. 

Sincerely,
Chen
